package.name: adhere_apriltag_detector
package.description: Wall-tag station detection for the KAMR-MPPI ROV (CLAUDE.md Phase 5.0 Stage 6): publishes TagDetection on /rov/tag_detection, the authoritative measured override for the coarse adhere_wall_tags preset. The simulated node (this package) is a proximity-triggered point publisher, not a vision pipeline -- the real robot's equivalent is apriltag_ros publishing the identical message on the identical topic, so AdhereController's consumer logic is unchanged between sim and real. Subscribes only to /rov/controller_state's estimated pose (never ground truth), staying Sim-to-Real pure. Zero dependency on MuJoCo/CUDA/ros2_control.
